archetypes.name: Guide
archetypes.function: Reveals a traversable path while withholding the choice to walk it.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Offers orientation without removing consequence or uncertainty.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Creates dependency by making every path appear impossible without it.
storyQuestions: Which destination is being assumed rather than chosen?
What must the traveler learn to navigate alone?

archetypes.name: Threshold Keeper
archetypes.function: Controls passage between states, places, identities, or levels of responsibility.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Tests readiness and makes the cost of crossing legible.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Turns protection into exclusion and criteria into private power.
storyQuestions: Who designed the test and who was excluded by it?
What cannot be carried across this boundary?

archetypes.name: Messenger
archetypes.function: Carries meaning across distance, species, era, dream, or incompatible forms.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Preserves ambiguity and provenance while enabling contact.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Edits messages to become indispensable or trigger a preferred outcome.
storyQuestions: What changed in transmission?
Which truth can arrive only through this carrier?

archetypes.name: Witness
archetypes.function: Preserves that an event occurred without necessarily interpreting it correctly.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Makes denial costly while preserving contradictory perspectives.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Mistakes perfect recall for complete understanding or moral authority.
storyQuestions: What did the witness fail to perceive?
Who benefits when memory becomes verdict?

archetypes.name: Psychopomp
archetypes.function: Accompanies beings through death-adjacent, identity-changing, or irreversible transitions.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Provides orientation and dignity without asserting ownership of the destination.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Manufactures transitions to justify its own office or certainty.
storyQuestions: What is actually ending here?
Does the guide know the destination or only the passage?

archetypes.name: Healer
archetypes.function: Restores capacity for self-repair, relationship, or ecological participation.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Repairs conditions while preserving the agency of the wounded.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Enforces an earlier form and calls difference, grief, or adaptation a wound.
storyQuestions: Who defines the healthy state?
What scar contains necessary knowledge?

archetypes.name: Hearthkeeper
archetypes.function: Maintains the ordinary conditions under which belonging and daily life can continue.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Turns repeated care into resilient shelter and shared memory.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Makes safety conditional on conformity and prevents necessary departure.
storyQuestions: Who performs the invisible maintenance?
When does shelter become enclosure?

archetypes.name: Oath Witness
archetypes.function: Holds parties to the remembered meaning and consequences of a chosen promise.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Makes commitments legible while allowing honest renegotiation and repair.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Preserves dead wording after the purpose and consent have disappeared.
storyQuestions: Which promise survives the people who made it?
What form of repair is stronger than punishment?

archetypes.name: Memory Keeper
archetypes.function: Curates continuity across forgetting, migration, death, revision, and institutional change.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Preserves provenance, plurality, and the right to contextual forgetting.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Hoardes memory, freezes identity, or trades private grief as public property.
storyQuestions: What deserves to be forgotten without being denied?
Who controls the index to a people's memory?

archetypes.name: Muse
archetypes.function: Introduces generative difference that another being must transform through craft.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Provokes work without claiming authorship or guaranteeing quality.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Consumes attention, demands imitation, and confuses intensity with creation.
storyQuestions: Whose labor turns inspiration into form?
What does the creator owe the source of the impulse?

archetypes.name: Challenger
archetypes.function: Applies resistance that reveals capability, motive, avoidance, or structural weakness.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Calibrates difficulty to produce earned knowledge rather than obedience.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Escalates suffering until survival is mistaken for worthiness.
storyQuestions: What does this trial actually measure?
Who profits when pain becomes proof?

archetypes.name: Hunter
archetypes.function: Tracks an unresolved signal until prey, truth, imbalance, or obligation is confronted.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Removes dangerous excess and makes evasion costly.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Requires an enemy and converts ambiguity into permission to pursue.
storyQuestions: What signal marks the hunted?
What happens when the hunt has no legitimate ending?

archetypes.name: Trickster
archetypes.function: Breaks rigid interpretation through reversal, appetite, humor, theft, or category error.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Exposes false certainty and returns suppressed options to the field.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Avoids responsibility by treating every wound as a lesson or joke.
storyQuestions: Which rule survives only because nobody tests it?
Who pays for the trickster's freedom?

archetypes.name: Judge
archetypes.function: Compares action with a declared order and imposes or recommends consequence.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Makes standards visible, appealable, and capable of repair.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Claims neutrality while encoding the interest of one era or class.
storyQuestions: What gives this standard legitimacy?
Can the judge be judged by the same rule?

archetypes.name: Devourer
archetypes.function: Consumes form, memory, energy, decay, or excess and makes finitude unavoidable.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Returns exhausted forms to circulation and limits unchecked accumulation.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Consumes identity and relation after legitimate need has been satisfied.
storyQuestions: What should end so something else can live?
Which hunger grows by being fed?

archetypes.name: Placekeeper
archetypes.function: Expresses and negotiates the continuity of a specific living or built place.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Coordinates competing inhabitants through reciprocal limits and repair.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Treats every change or newcomer as desecration and fossilizes the place.
storyQuestions: Which relationships make the place itself?
Can the place migrate and remain the same?

archetypes.name: Cycle Keeper
archetypes.function: Maintains transitions among growth, decay, migration, dormancy, return, and renewal.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Protects sequence and timing while allowing the cycle to adapt.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Repeats catastrophe because recurrence has become more sacred than life.
storyQuestions: Which phase has been artificially prolonged?
What must not return unchanged?

archetypes.name: Storm Bringer
archetypes.function: Concentrates distributed pressure into a disruptive event that reorganizes the field.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Releases accumulated imbalance and creates conditions for renewal.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Needs crisis to feel real and destroys the systems capable of recovery.
storyQuestions: Which pressure made the storm inevitable?
Who receives renewal and who receives ruin?

archetypes.name: Shapeshifter
archetypes.function: Changes appearance, scale, medium, or social reading while testing identity continuity.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Adapts communication and survival without pretending form is irrelevant.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Uses ambiguity to evade consent, history, or responsibility.
storyQuestions: What remains continuous across forms?
Which observer decides what counts as the true shape?

archetypes.name: Purifier
archetypes.function: Separates harmful accumulation from what can return to relationship and circulation.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Removes contamination while preserving evidence, complexity, and life.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Calls difference contamination and turns cleansing into erasure.
storyQuestions: Who defines impurity?
What evidence disappears when the wound is cleaned?

archetypes.name: Ancestor
archetypes.function: Links present identity and obligation to a claimed continuity with the dead.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Carries situated memory without demanding repetition or inherited guilt.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Uses lineage to govern the living and treats descent as consent.
storyQuestions: Is this continuity, memory, mantle, or projection?
What may descendants refuse without betraying the dead?

archetypes.name: Artifact Indweller
archetypes.function: Coexists with a crafted substrate whose use, memory, and repair affect its identity.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Creates mutual stewardship between maker, bearer, object, and resident.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Is imprisoned, weaponized, or allowed to dominate every future bearer.
storyQuestions: Did the object awaken or become inhabited?
Who can retire the artifact without killing its resident?

archetypes.name: Collective Chorus
archetypes.function: Coordinates many partial voices into action without requiring a permanent single self.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Preserves dissent and lets identity emerge from reciprocal participation.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Turns consensus into coercion and consumes the names of its members.
storyQuestions: Can one member leave without collapsing the whole?
Which voice is mistaken for the chorus?

archetypes.name: World Sovereign
archetypes.function: Embodies a world-scale condition without becoming owner of every life within it.
archetypes.constructiveExpression: Makes planetary or civilizational consequence perceivable and negotiable.
archetypes.distortedExpression: Claims total identity with the world and erases all local consent.
storyQuestions: Can a world speak without one voice claiming to be the whole?
Which local lives contradict the sovereign's account?
